name: Classified REJECT intent on a still-gated run → dispatch the apply consumer
description:
The reject intent route (nl-conversation-intent group 4, design D6) — the exact mirror of 03a-route-intent-approve for conversation.intent.value = reject. The same deterministic apply consumer (component.conversation-apply.dispatch) re-checks the gate is open, re-Authorizes the HARNESS-bound cited author, posts the transparency comment, and stamps run.change.decision = "reject" under the one G5 writer (approval-adapter); the phase-guarded run-lifecycle CANCEL rule (group 5) then fires awaiting_approval → cancelled — never this rule, never Go (G2). See 03a for the full mechanism notes: run-as-dispatch-entity, the gate-undecided guard (H4a), the gate fact as the self-extinguisher, and the no-marker rationale (idempotent consumer, M6 Post-then-stamp).

WHY approve and reject are TWO rules, not one: the engine's condition set is a flat AND (a single rule cannot express value ∈ {approve,reject} without logic:or, and a guarded pure-AND pair is the house OR-collapse shape — 06b/06e precedent), and the taxonomy census pins exactly one route per directive intent. `none` deliberately routes NOWHERE: no directive means the run stays gated (D1).

metadata.station: intent route (reject) — dispatch the deterministic apply consumer (group 4, design D6)
metadata.firing_cap: max_iterations: 0 (grp4-review H1) — same rationale as 03a: legitimate unbounded re-fire on one run across the gate lifetime; the default per-action cap of 3 would silently stop routing.
metadata.trigger_rationale: fires on the RUN; the run travels as the dispatch entity_id. Mirrors 03a exactly — one route per directive intent, censused.
metadata.mutual_exclusion: phase-gate + both-gate-facts-absent (H4a); the landing gate fact extinguishes the trigger. The reject→cancel transition is the group-5 run-lifecycle rule's, phase-guarded to awaiting_approval (H1) — the conversation pack owns no transition (G2).
